meta.title: 超级大宝贝
meta.description: A pixel nuke above the account avatar. Click five times to charge it: each click shakes it, adds 20% scale and plays a rising charge pop; stopping shrinks it one step every 0.8 seconds. At full charge it ignites, passes the whale and arcs into the centre with a whoosh, then detonates with a 20% larger blast, layered boom and a violent shake of the whole app viewport, before quitting DeepSeek Harness and its background processes.
